verdict.rationale: Plugging in MCP servers is a fair question for an AI assistant like Copilot, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents a fixed set of first-party consumer connectors (OneDrive, Outlook.com, Google Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Contacts). Nothing shows a way to add arbitrary MCP servers or use their tools. Those connectors are an adjacent feature, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
